description:
• Web Application Developer -Senior Level. 
 • Must have: C#, AngularJS, SQL experience. 
 • Nice to haves: BreezeJS, CSS, RESTful service development, mobile first web design, Entity Framework, Windows Workflow (WF), Grunt, Gulp, Subversion (SVN). 
 • For the senior level candidates, we’re looking for someone with the skills listed above who can articulate the strengths and weaknesses to alternative frameworks. 
 • These applications are web-based data-entry systems. 
 • Typical daily work will be screen layout/design with Angular bindings. 
 • Typescript coded controllers and C# RESTful services to support the screens. 

 • Builds software applications – Follows coding standards, builds appropriate unit tests, integration tests and deployment scripts 
 • Assists in defining software architectures – Collaborates with development leads to explore existing systems, determines areas of complexity, potential risks to successful implementation, learns the applications capabilities 
 • Communicates continually with the client and project teams – Explains progress on the development effort 
 • Owns success – Takes responsibility for successful delivery of the solutions 
 • Translates designs and style guides provided by the architecture team into functional user interfaces, ensuring cross browser compatibility and performance 
 • Contributes to continual improvement by suggesting improvements to user interface, software architecture or new technologies. 
 • Able to build appropriate interface to back-end databases such as Oracle/Netezza. 
 • Build out of infrastructure in IIS. 
 
 Required Skills: 
 Highly skilled at front-end engineering using Object-Oriented JavaScript, various JavaScript libraries and micro frameworks (JQuery, Angular, Breeze, Dojo, Backbone, YUI, HTML5, and CSS) 
 Well-versed in software engineering principles, frameworks and technologies 
 Excellent communication skills 
 Self-directed team player who thrives in a continually changing environment 
 Strong customer service/client service skills
